# People Atlas 0.10.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.10.0 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.10.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

0.10.0 is the installable successor to the assetless 0.9.0 Alpha prerelease.
Use this release rather than 0.9.0.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- A canonical person in Reading View now exposes **Add relationship** next to
  **Edit person**. The action revalidates its source when activated and does not
  write until an editor/modal is explicitly saved.
- The current canonical graph detail sheet continues to offer **Open note** for
  its linked local Markdown note.
- The regular Settings view now keeps only daily choices: **People root
  folder**, **My person**, **Relationship templates**, and **Show labels**.
  Stored technical schema settings remain readable but are no longer presented
  as ordinary editable controls.
- This release also contains the presentation-first person dossier layout:
  readable safe folder names by default, a shortest UUID-derived suffix only on
  canonical-name collisions, and stable `person_id` values as canonical
  identity.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.10.0 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
